title: An empty cookie unlocks Xen Orchestra, and CISA's deadline is Saturday
short:
A cookie holding only an empty pair of braces can log attackers into Xen Orchestra. CISA listed it as exploited, with most fixes due Saturday.
Full story: https://badeifer.github.io/news/xen-orchestra-empty-cookie-kev/
#cybersecurity #CISA #XenOrchestra #patching

linkedin:
CISA added ten exploited flaws to its catalog on 25 November, with most due for federal agencies by Saturday. The worst lets an attacker log into Xen Orchestra with a cookie holding an empty pair of braces. Fixes are in 6.9.2 and 6.10.1.

The same attacker used a second flaw to reach the hosts underneath, and that one had no fix at Vates's last update. Strip VM import rights, keep the console off the internet and hunt for traces. https://badeifer.github.io/news/xen-orchestra-empty-cookie-kev/
